description: The narrowest set of permissions the UI actually uses. Everything SwiftLoad does with the filesystem and the network goes through the engine's own commands, which are auditable Rust; the plugin surface is limited to what a web view genuinely cannot do for itself -- pick a folder, hand a path to the shell, raise a notification, and show a tray icon. Autostart is deliberately absent: it is toggled through our own command, so the decision goes through Rust rather than being reachable from page script.
